_notes: batch_size=64 x context_length=256 = 16,384 tokens/step; max_steps=30000 -> ~491M tokens, approximately one pass over the ~500.24M-token Nepali train split. Values are starting points meant to be adjusted once real Kaggle-GPU step throughput is measured; checkpointing every 1000 steps (with full optimizer/scheduler/step state) is what makes resuming across separate Kaggle sessions possible.
